meta.description: Draws a floor plan of the home: the rooms as shapes, with sensor readings and plants at their positions, zoomable and editable.

floorplan.name: Floor plan
floorplan.description: The rooms of a floor with sensor readings and plants where they stand; administrators place them and edit the rooms.
floorplan.no_plan: No floor plan yet. Make one with the floorplan-from-image skill or domosenso floorplan push.
floorplan.unsupported: This floor plan was written in a newer format than this card reads. Update the floorplan component.

hint.empty: This floor has no rooms or sensors yet.
hint.move: Drag sensors and corners. Double-click a wall to add a corner, a corner to remove it. Tap a room to link it to an area.
hint.split: Tap two points on the walls of one room.
hint.join: Tap two neighbouring rooms; the first keeps its area.

tray.title: Not on the plan
tray.empty: Every sensor is on the plan.
tray.drag_group: Drag onto the plan to place them all; tap to open

floorplan.changed_elsewhere: The plan was changed elsewhere since this page loaded it. Nothing was saved: reload the page and edit again.
floorplan.create_failed: The area could not be created: {error}
floorplan.refused: That change is not possible here.
